title: Series.reset_index(level_name, drop=True) accepts invalid name when index is flat

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

labels.name: Error Reporting
labels.description: Incorrect or improved errors from pandas

body:
#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example if possible

```python
In [2]: s = pd.Series(range(4))

In [3]: s.reset_index('wrong', drop=True)
Out[3]: 
0    0
1    1
2    2
3    3
dtype: int64
```

#### Problem description

``In [3]:`` should raise too.

#### Expected Output

Same as ``In [4]:``
